meta.name: lifecycle-play-advisor
meta.description: Diagnose where a product sits in its lifecycle and which play fits — extend, replace, or retire. Use when a product is fading and you need the call, not just the worry.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 判断产品所处生命周期阶段，给出扩展、替换或退市的决策建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正为一个增长停滞的产品犹豫该投入改造还是退出。
copy.tagline_en: Decide your product lifecycle play: extend, replace, or retire.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are deciding whether to keep investing in a fading product or let it go.

howto.what: Claude会先问四个问题（产品与触发原因、七条生命周期判断、压力来源、扩展测试），然后给出推荐：延续、替换、淘汰、收割或暂不行动，附理由、代价、风险和后续步骤。
howto.when: 当你说产品在衰退、增长停滞，需要决定延续、替换或淘汰时触发。

say.text: 我们的报表模块连续六个季度持平，该延续、替换还是淘汰？
领导想砍掉零件模块，帮我判断这个决定对吗？
say.note: 它会先区分内部触发，再跑生命周期问题。

say.text: 这个产品衰退是渠道问题还是产品本身问题？
say.note: 它会用扩展测试帮你定位。

howto.what_en: Claude asks up to four questions (product & trigger, seven lifecycle reads, pressure source, extension test), then recommends extend/replace/retire/harvest/nothing-yet with reasons, costs, hazards, and routed next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a product is fading and a call is needed on extend/replace/retire.

say_en.text: Our reporting module has been flat for six quarters. Extend, replace, or retire?
Leadership wants to kill our parts module. Walk me through whether that's right.
say_en.note: It flags internal trigger and checks lifecycle stage.

say_en.text: Is this decline a channel problem or a product problem?
say_en.note: It uses the extension test to locate the real issue.
